{"summary":"A rollout has been running for 20 minutes without completing, exceeding the default 600‑second progress deadline, so the Deployment is likely marked as stalled (Progressing=False).","likely_cause":"Stalled rollout due to exceeding .spec.progressDeadlineSeconds (default 10 min); common underlying reasons include readiness probe failures, image pull errors, quota or permission issues as listed in the documentation.","confidence":"high","next_action":"1. Run `kubectl rollout status deployment/<name>` to confirm the deadline error.
2. Run `kubectl describe deployment <name>` and inspect the `Progressing` condition and Events for specific failures (e.g., readiness probe, image pull, quota).
3. If needed, increase the deadline temporarily with `kubectl patch deployment <name> -p '{"spec":{"progressDeadlineSeconds":<seconds>}}'`.
4. Resolve the root issue identified (fix probe, correct image, adjust quota/permissions).
5. Resume or re‑trigger the rollout (`kubectl rollout restart deployment/<name>`), then monitor until `kubectl get deployment` shows all replicas updated."}
